settings.title: Fresher complexion
settings.review: “The mask is easy to set up and start using immediately. My primary concern is discoloration from sun exposure and fine line/wrinkle prevention. I have very dry skin and after 2.5 weeks, I can tell a significant difference in my skin’s moisture. Especially since it is the middle of winter. The discoloration on my forehead is also evening out and the red, patchy spots on my cheeks are not as inflamed.”
settings.customer_name_with_prod: Kayla uses the Q-Rejuvalight Pro LED Mask

settings.title: Renewed skin!
settings.review: My Qure mask has been amazing! As someone who struggles with acne and rosacea, your LED light therapy mask has improved my skin so much that I an now feel comfortable without any makeup. I’m very happy with this product!
settings.customer_name_with_prod: Tiffany uses the Q-Rejuvalight Pro LED Mask

settings.title: Healthier-looking glow
settings.review: “I was shocked seeing my before and after photos!! I didn’t realise how much my skin improved. I feel so much more confident wearing open tops now. settings.title: Wish I had this technology years ago!
settings.review: “After two weeks I began to see results and after six weeks the changes in my skin were dramatic. I have now been using Qure six months and loving the compliments! I bought masks for my daughters for Christmas so they could start at a younger age…. I wish this technology had been available when I was younger. I am 76 years old! Photos below are after 6 weeks.”
